annotations.title: Create a new event as a draft (organizers)

description: Creates a new event for the signed-in person, as the organizer dashboard's New event does: `name`, `kind`, `dateStart`, optional `dateEnd` (at most 14 days), `venue` and `city`. It is saved as a DRAFT nobody can find until published, and the creator is its organizer. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PREVIEW with a `confirmToken` and saves nothing; only when the person says yes, call again with the same arguments, `confirm: true` and that token. NAME_TAKEN comes with a free `suggestion` for `webAddress`. Refusals are read out as given. It requires a personal connector token. Optional `startTime`, `endTime` (one day) and `color` show in the preview. Write the product name in full: Sonar Connections. Optional `hostedBy` is a display line, not a co-host.

confirm.description: Absent on the first call, which saves nothing; true with confirmToken saves.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned.

customColor.description: Optional #rrggbb; a hard to read color is refused with the closest readable shade. For the new draft only; an existing event's colors change through event_change_detail.

dateStart.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

hostedBy.description: Display line "Hosted by ...". Not a co-host.

kind.description: "private event" for any party or gathering that is not a wedding or birthday; else birthday, wedding, conference, market and so on. Never ask the person to pick from a list.

language.description: With templateId: the language of the guests' system text.

name.description: The event name as it should show.

paletteId.description: With templateId: one of its palette ids. For the new draft only; an existing event's colors change through event_change_detail.

rsvp.description: True turns RSVP on. Absent: off.

songs.description: With templateId: song requests on or off.

templateId.description: Optional; a template id from the dashboard (birthday_party, quince_classic, baby_shower_soft, wedding_gallery).

time.description: With templateId: the start time, HH:MM, 24 hour, local.
